name: probe-port-meets-gallery
why: The manifold of docs/PERCEPTION.md §3, whose two voids a model once read as not meeting. Across the part at the port's x and the gallery's height, the ray enters the block at y = -15, leaves it into void at y = -5 through the port's wall (the port is Ø10, so its wall, not the Ø8 gallery's, bounds the void there), re-enters at +5 through the port's wall, and leaves at +15: four crossings named block, port, port, block, 20 mm of material, a first run of 10. The thinnest wall is the 5 mm left outboard of the port — the block runs to x = -30 and the port to -25 — between the port's wall and the block's face, a sampled minimum exact at its own point and within a thousandth of the generator's 5.000.
